description: This file defines a migration class for version 5.8.0 of OrangeHRM, handling database schema updates including foreign key adjustments, column modifications, and localization string updates.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Represents a database schema migration for OrangeHRM version 5.8.0, including methods to modify schema, handle foreign keys, and update language strings.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the schema upgrade and language string updates for this migration version.

methods.name: correctingCurrencyIdColumnInconsistencies
methods.description: Fixes charset and collation inconsistencies for 'currency_id' columns and updates foreign keys accordingly.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign keys in specified table that reference 'hs_hr_currency_type'.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops conflicting foreign key constraints from specified tables.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Restores previously dropped foreign key constraints.

methods.name: getNativeConnection
methods.description: Returns the PDO native connection object.

methods.name: disableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Disables foreign key checks for schema modifications.

methods.name: enableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Re-enables foreign key checks after schema modifications.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration ('5.8.0').

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LangStringHelper for handling localization strings.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database.

calls: getConnection()->executeStatement('ALTER TABLE hs_hr_currency_type MODIFY COLUMN currency_id VARCHAR(3) CHARACTER SET utf8mb3 COLLATE utf8mb3_general_ci')
